tools.name: storage_list_volumes
tools.description: List detected volumes with filesystem, state, mount decision and mount point.

tools.name: storage_preview_mount
tools.description: Show how a volume would be mounted, and why, without mounting it.

tools.name: storage_mount
tools.description: Mount a volume by its UOS volume identifier. The storage policy may grant less access than requested; it never grants more.

tools.name: storage_unmount
tools.description: Unmount a volume by its UOS volume identifier.

tools.name: storage_unlock
tools.description: Ask the system to unlock an encrypted volume. The passphrase is entered by the user in a system prompt and is never given to the assistant.
